1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 c5 4.d5 b5 5.Bg5.strategy: Recaptures towards the centre, which also ends the attack on b5, so material is level. White has a pawn on d5 and space, Black a queenside majority and active pieces; the pinned knight on f6 is the first thing Black has to solve.

Puts the question to the bishop at once and so deals with the pin on the f6 knight. If White trades on f6, Black recaptures with the queen, which then eyes the long diagonal towards b2; if the bishop retreats, Black has spent a tempo but keeps its knight and solid centre.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 c5 4.d5 b5 5.Bg5.name: Blumenfeld Countergambit: Spielmann Variation
